text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Etsuko Otonashi invites Taiki<n>Shuttle along
to watch the Takarazuka<n>Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There are two runners to watch out<n>for—the
previous Umamusume of the<n>Year, Air Groove, and
the current<n>favorite Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Silence Suzuka reigns<n>victorious with a
stunning breakaway,<n>winning over the hearts of
even more<n>fans.
